sloka: तथा तु शपथैः कष्टैः शपमानम् अचेतनम् ।भरतम् शोक सम्तप्तम् कौसल्या वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-७५-६०॥
transliteration: tathā tu śapathaiḥ kaṣṭaiḥ śapamānam acetanam ।bharatam śoka samtaptam kausalyā vākyam abravīt ॥2-75-60॥

translations.english: Kausalya said these words to Bharata who fell unconscious, consumed with grief, while swearing on painful oaths.
